frames.narration: After 'The cat sat on the', the model gives a raw score to every token: a 4, b 3, c 2, d 1, e 0.
Temperature 1 turns the scores into probabilities: a 0.636, b 0.234, c 0.086, d 0.032, e 0.012.
Temperature 0.5 sharpens them: a rises to 0.865. Temperature 2 flattens them: a falls to 0.429. Low temperature is nearly greedy.
Top-p 0.9 keeps the smallest set that adds up to 0.9: a, b and c (together 0.957). d and e are cut off.
The three that remain are renormalised to a 0.665, b 0.245 and c 0.090.
The sampler draws one of them at random, adds it to the text and asks the model for the next position.
